goal: Check that each production change has an approval, a test result, a rollback plan and a record.
use: Check that each production change has an approval, a test result, a rollback plan and a record. Use when a change process must be shown to follow policy.

steps.note: Read the change record. Take the change as recorded: its ticket, author, reviewer and date.
Check approval. The approver must be someone other than the author.
Check testing. A passing test result must be linked to the change.
Check the rollback. A rollback plan must be recorded for each production change.
Check the timing. Emergency changes need a record made afterwards.
Report. A list of changes with the status of each control, and the exceptions to follow up.

protocol.title: Read the change record
protocol.text: Take the change as recorded: its ticket, author, reviewer and date.

protocol.title: Check approval
protocol.text: The approver must be someone other than the author. Flag self-approved or unapproved changes.

protocol.title: Check testing
protocol.text: A passing test result must be linked to the change.

protocol.title: Check the rollback
protocol.text: A rollback plan must be recorded for each production change.

protocol.title: Check the timing
protocol.text: Emergency changes need a record made afterwards. Flag changes with no record at all.

protocol.title: Report
protocol.text: A list of changes with the status of each control, and the exceptions to follow up.
